abandon.en: The hikers had to abandon their plan because of the sudden storm.
abandon.zh: 登山客因為突如其來的暴風雨，只好放棄原本的計畫。

abbreviate.en: To save space, the editor abbreviated several common expressions in the chart.
abbreviate.zh: 為了節省空間，編輯把圖表中的幾個常用詞組縮寫了。

ability.en: She has the ability to explain difficult ideas clearly.
ability.zh: 她有能力把困難的概念解釋得很清楚。

abolish.en: The government decided to abolish the outdated rule after years of public debate.
abolish.zh: 經過多年的公共討論後，政府決定廢除這項過時的規定。

absence.en: Her repeated absence from class made it difficult for her to keep up with the lessons.
absence.zh: 她一再缺課，使她很難跟上課程進度。

absorb.en: Plants absorb water through their roots and use it to grow.
absorb.zh: 植物透過根部吸收水分，並利用水分生長。

abstract.en: Some abstract ideas become easier to understand when they are explained with examples.
abstract.zh: 有些抽象概念在搭配例子說明後會比較容易理解。

abundant.en: Fresh water is abundant in some regions but extremely limited in others.
abundant.zh: 淡水在某些地區很充足，但在其他地區卻極為有限。

abuse.en: The new policy was designed to prevent the abuse of personal information.
abuse.zh: 這項新政策是為了防止個人資料遭到濫用。

academic.en: The school provides extra academic support before major exams.
academic.zh: 學校會在大型考試前提供額外的學業輔導。

accelerate.en: New technology may accelerate the spread of information across the world.
accelerate.zh: 新科技可能會加速資訊在全球傳播的速度。

accept.en: Learning to accept different opinions is an important part of teamwork.
accept.zh: 學會接受不同的意見，是團隊合作中很重要的一部分。

access.en: Students can access the digital library from home with their school accounts.
access.zh: 學生可以使用學校帳號從家中存取數位圖書館。

accompany.en: A teacher will accompany the students on their visit to the science museum.
accompany.zh: 一位老師會陪同學生參觀科學博物館。

accomplish.en: The team worked together to accomplish a task that seemed impossible at first.
accomplish.zh: 這個團隊共同合作，完成了一項起初看似不可能的任務。

accumulate.en: Small amounts of plastic can accumulate in the ocean over many years.
accumulate.zh: 少量的塑膠經過多年可能會逐漸累積在海洋中。

accurate.en: Accurate information is essential when you write a research report.
accurate.zh: 撰寫研究報告時，準確的資訊非常重要。

accuse.en: It is unfair to accuse someone without enough evidence.
accuse.zh: 在沒有足夠證據的情況下指控別人是不公平的。

achieve.en: With steady practice, you can achieve your academic goals.
achieve.zh: 只要持續練習，你就能達成學業上的目標。

acknowledge.en: The writer acknowledged that the first explanation was incomplete.
acknowledge.zh: 作者承認第一個解釋並不完整。

adjust.en: It may take a few weeks to adjust to a new study schedule.
adjust.zh: 適應新的讀書作息可能需要幾個星期。

affect.en: Lack of sleep can affect your concentration in class.
affect.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你在課堂上的專注力。

analyze.en: Students were asked to analyze the causes of the problem.
analyze.zh: 學生被要求分析這個問題發生的原因。

annual.en: The school holds an annual science fair every spring.
annual.zh: 學校每年春天都會舉辦科學展覽。

approach.en: We need a different approach to solve this complicated problem.
approach.zh: 我們需要用不同的方法來解決這個複雜的問題。

assume.en: Do not assume that every source on the Internet is reliable.
assume.zh: 不要以為網路上的每個資訊來源都可靠。

available.en: The new learning materials are available online for free.
available.zh: 新的學習教材可以在網路上免費取得。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both your body and your mind.
benefit.zh: 規律運動對身體與心理都有好處。

challenge.en: Learning to manage your time is a common challenge for high school students.
challenge.zh: 學會管理時間，是高中生常見的挑戰。

consequence.en: Every decision may have a consequence that we did not expect.
consequence.zh: 每個決定都可能帶來我們沒有預料到的後果。

consider.en: You should consider several factors before making a final decision.
consider.zh: 做最後決定前，你應該考慮幾項因素。

contribute.en: Small daily habits can contribute to long-term success.
contribute.zh: 每天的小習慣可以促成長期的成功。

develop.en: Reading widely can help students develop stronger critical-thinking skills.
develop.zh: 廣泛閱讀能幫助學生培養更好的批判思考能力。

environment.en: A quiet environment can make it easier to concentrate on studying.
environment.zh: 安靜的環境能讓人更容易專心讀書。

evidence.en: The scientist collected more evidence before drawing a conclusion.
evidence.zh: 科學家在下結論前蒐集了更多證據。

factor.en: Cost is only one factor to consider when choosing a school.
factor.zh: 費用只是選擇學校時要考慮的其中一項因素。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline study mode.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線學習模式。

impact.en: Social media can have a strong impact on the way people communicate.
impact.zh: 社群媒體會對人們溝通的方式產生很大的影響。

indicate.en: The results indicate that regular review improves long-term memory.
indicate.zh: 結果顯示，規律複習能提升長期記憶。

individual.en: Each individual may respond to the same situation differently.
individual.zh: 每個人面對相同情況時，反應可能都不一樣。

involve.en: The project will involve students from several different classes.
involve.zh: 這項計畫將會有好幾個不同班級的學生參與。

issue.en: The class discussed the issue from several different points of view.
issue.zh: 全班從幾個不同的角度討論這項議題。

maintain.en: It is easier to maintain a study habit when your daily goal is realistic.
maintain.zh: 每天的目標訂得實際，比較容易維持讀書習慣。

occur.en: Most accidents occur when people stop paying attention to their surroundings.
occur.zh: 大多數意外都發生在人們不再注意周遭環境的時候。

participate.en: Students are encouraged to participate actively in class discussions.
participate.zh: 老師鼓勵學生主動參與課堂討論。

provide.en: The chart provides useful information about changes over time.
provide.zh: 這張圖表提供了有關長期變化的實用資訊。

require.en: This task requires careful reading and logical thinking.
require.zh: 這項任務需要仔細閱讀與邏輯思考。

significant.en: There was a significant improvement in her reading speed after months of practice.
significant.zh: 經過幾個月的練習後，她的閱讀速度有了明顯進步。

specific.en: Give a specific example to support your main idea.
specific.zh: 請舉一個具體的例子來支持你的主要想法。

suggest.en: The data suggest that students learn better when they review regularly.
suggest.zh: 資料顯示，學生規律複習時學習效果比較好。

support.en: Use facts and examples to support your argument.
support.zh: 請用事實與例子來支持你的論點。

therefore.en: The road was closed; therefore, we had to take another route.
therefore.zh: 道路封閉了，因此我們只好改走另一條路。

various.en: The library offers various resources for students preparing for exams.
various.zh: 圖書館提供各種資源給準備考試的學生。
